content.comment_body: Has anyone worked with the Insys IMON-G100 to monitor [product_name] [article_no] over LAN? Is it possible to monitor multiple units?
Yes, you can monitor one or several [product_name] units over LAN. See this link: [url]
We use the IMON-G100 in our solar-powered systems and it interacts well with [article_no].

I've ordered the new [company_name] [product_name] Communication Interface Module (CIM) [article_no], but I haven't received it for testing yet. A vendor is also trying to connect a Cloudgate Option Mini to a [product_name], with no success so far. What is that small [company_name] box at the top? Is it an Ethernet to 232 converter?
A new question from [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread regarding 3G discontinuation and IMON-G300 being unusable—what replacement supports 4G? Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users have reported that the Insys IMON-G100 can reliably monitor several [product_name] [article_no] devices over LAN, including in solar-powered setups. Feedback points to good compatibility and stable operation. There is ongoing interest in integrating additional communication modules and cloud connectivity, as well as questions regarding related hardware such as Ethernet converters. No major issues or critical failures have been mentioned.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect dependable LAN-based monitoring for multiple [product_name] [article_no] devices, straightforward setup, and compatibility with other communication options.
